description:
About the Team

The AI & Data Platform team builds the foundation that makes Vantage's retail media platform intelligent. We own the data platform that turns campaign activity across onsite, offsite, and in-store channels into the trusted reporting that retailers and brands rely on to understand what their advertising delivers. And we're building Vantage's AI platform: the intelligent systems, automation, and workflows that help advertisers scale their operations, and the foundation that lets every team at Vantage bring agents into the product safely.

About the Role

In this role you'll focus on building and evolving the data platform behind Vantage's reporting and the AI platform that lets teams build agents on top of it, while acting as a subject matter expert and mentor for our engineering team. Expect heavy use of external APIs and data feeds to pull data from ad platforms and partner systems, as well as designing and delivering pipelines, data models, and agent-facing services that other teams at Vantage depend on. You'll work with large datasets, perform hands-on coding, and keep our pipelines and services reliable, and fast.

In this role you'll be called on to support multiple product teams to uphold sound architecture, high code quality, and on-time delivery across both halves of what we own. On the data side, you'll be a trusted go-to reviewer for SQL, dbt, and data model changes, and set clear standards for warehouse performance and data trust. On the AI side, you'll shape the intelligent systems and automated workflows advertisers rely on inside Vantage and how other teams build agents on our platform: which tools an agent can call, how it reaches data securely, and whether the answer it gives actually solves the customer's problem. We're a platform team, but we measure ourselves by what our customers can do with what we build. You'll talk to the people who use it, care about whether it delights them, and guide design and trade-off decisions that keep the platform scalable while solving real problems.

This posting is for an existing vacancy (backfill).

Minimum Requirements

  • 6+ years of professional experience with a strong record in software development, testing, software design, and architecture.

  • Advanced SQL expertise: comfortable reading query plans, designing data models, tuning complex joins and aggregations, and refactoring queries for reliability and speed on large datasets.

  • Hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse and a transformation framework such as dbt, including dimensional modelling (star schema or medallion architectures).

  • Experience building with LLMs in production: agent frameworks (e.g. LangGraph or LangChain), tool use, and protocols such as MCP, with an understanding of how to give agents secure, scoped access to data.

  • Experience as a gatekeeper for data quality and query performance in code reviews and debugging sessions, with a demonstrated ability to both diagnose and prevent issues.

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and debug production pipelines and services using logs, metrics, and traces.

  • Experience with cloud platforms, Docker, and CI/CD tooling such as CircleCI or GitHub Actions.

  • Experience with B2B API and data integrations, and with relational databases such as MySQL or Postgres.

  • Track record of effective mentoring and knowledge sharing.

  • Nice to have: Experience with Snowflake and streaming data systems, or with managed LLM platforms, evals, and guardrails. A degree in Computer Science or a related field is a plus.

Role Responsibilities

  • Own data platform performance and quality. Review pull requests with an eye for query cost, data model design, test coverage, and freshness, and drive improvements across the warehouse.

  • Own data ingestion and integrations. Build and maintain reliable connectors to ad platforms and partner systems, including authentication, rate limiting, and retries, and define how other Vantage teams land data on the platform.

  • Design and ship transformation pipelines and data models in SQL, dbt, and Python that turn raw data into trusted, query-ready datasets with predictable latency and high reliability.

  • Build and evolve the AI platform: agent-facing services and MCP tools that expose data to agents with per-user identity and access controls, and the shared patterns other teams use to build their own agents on Vantage.

  • Diagnose production issues, lead debugging sessions, and improve observability using logs, metrics, and traces. Proactively identify performance, cost, and data-quality risks and coach the team on preventing regressions, backed by strong automated tests and clear documentation.

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, design reviews, and actionable feedback, and stay close to the people who use what we build: advertisers scaling their operations on our automation, product teams querying the data, and engineers building agents on the platform. Bring their problems into architectural decisions so the platform scales and solves real customer needs.

About Vantage
Vantage is the first unified platform purpose-built for retail media orchestration, empowering enterprise retailers to seamlessly activate onsite, offsite, and in-store advertising. With a global presence in North America and Asia-Pacific, Vantage enables retailers to launch and grow their media networks through scalable technology and automated workflows, and is trusted by leading retailers like The Home Depot to power their retail media programs.

For a closer look at what we do, our culture, and our benefits, check out our about us and careers pages.

Remote-First, Based in Toronto
Vantage is proudly headquartered in Toronto, but we’re a remote-first team spread across North America (and beyond). Our flexible work philosophy means team members can thrive from wherever they do their best work—whether that’s from a home office, a local café, or while adding stamps to their passport. With a remote-friendly setup, home office support, and annual company retreats, we stay connected, collaborative, and energized—no matter the time zone.

Vantage’s Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Vantage Analytics is fueled by the diversity of our talented employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and embrace ALL individuals and what makes them unique. We believe our employees should be happy and healthy, with peace of mind and a sense of fulfillment. We encourage all individuals to apply for positions that fit their passions.

We promote equality and strive to provide all current and prospective employees with support and opportunities. Reasonable accommodations are available to job applicants on request and throughout the application process.

How Vantage Uses AI in the Recruitment Process

At Vantage, we use AI-enabled tools to support our hiring process. This may include using AI to help organize, screen, and assess applications. We are committed to using these tools responsibly, and ensuring every candidate is treated fairly throughout the process.

All hiring decisions at Vantage are made by our team. Who we invite to work at Vantage is a decision we only trust ourselves to make.

What's Next?
We thank all applicants in advance for their interest in this position, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

As part of the final stages of our hiring process, all candidates will be required to successfully complete a criminal background check.
